title: Bloody Spell
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#316, 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.4 beta and 0.10.6 beta, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19 then r21, D3DMetal. First rated 2 of 5 (hangs after the difficulty selection on D3DMetal, DXMT and DXVK alike) in an older environment, then 5 of 5 after installing the game into a fresh environment, in game at about 28 fps at 1920x1080 per the Metal HUD in their screenshot. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Plays in a fresh environment on D3DMetal on the default engine, about 28 fps at 1920x1080 on an M1 in the reporter's screenshot. The title screen's text needs Microsoft's core fonts, which the recipe installs. The same player first saw the game hang right after the difficulty selection on every graphics mode, with Wine's media pipeline stuck in the log, in an older environment whose Steam also stalled downloads (highball#258). A new environment cured both, so the hang belongs to that environment, not to the game. A DualSense controller was read without Steam Input on the first run and only with it on the next one.

knownIssues.cause: the game's fonts fall back to ones the environment does not ship
knownIssues.fix: Microsoft's core fonts, which the recipe installs

knownIssues.symptom: Hangs right after the difficulty selection, on every graphics mode
knownIssues.cause: seen in one older environment only, with Wine's media pipeline stuck in the log; the game played in a fresh environment
knownIssues.fix: install the game into a fresh environment
